description: This source file defines an AzureBlobService class providing an interface to interact with Azure Blob Storage, including listing, downloading, and uploading blobs with retry logic and error handling. It also defines custom exceptions mapping Azure errors to project-specific errors.

classes.name: AzureBlobError
classes.description: Base exception class for errors related to Azure Blob operations.

classes.name: BlobNotFoundError
classes.description: Exception raised when a specified blob is not found.

classes.name: ContainerNotFoundError
classes.description: Exception raised when a specified container is not found.

classes.name: BlobAlreadyExistsError
classes.description: Exception raised when attempting to create a blob that already exists and overwrite is not allowed.

classes.name: AzureBlobService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to interact with Azure Blob Storage, including list, download, upload, and existence checks.

methods.name: AzureBlobError _map_azure_error(exc: AzureError)
methods.description: Maps Azure-specific exceptions to internal project exceptions based on error type and status code.

methods.name: None __init__(self, connection_string: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Initializes the AzureBlobService with a connection string and configures retry policies.

methods.name: ContainerClient _container_client(self, container: str)
methods.description: Returns a container client for the specified container name.

methods.name: BlobClient _blob_client(self, container: str, blob_name: str)
methods.description: Returns a blob client for the specified container and blob name.

methods.name: Generator[str,None,None] list_blobs(self, container: str, prefix: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Lists names of blobs in a specified container, optionally filtered by prefix.

methods.name: str download_text(self, container: str, blob_name: str, encoding: str = "utf-8")
methods.description: Downloads the content of a blob as a text string.

methods.name: bytes download_bytes(self, container: str, blob_name: str)
methods.description: Downloads the content of a blob as bytes.

methods.name: None upload_text( self, container: str, blob_name: str, data: str, overwrite: Optional[bool] = None, content_type: str = "text/plain; charset=utf-8", encoding: str = "utf-8", )
methods.description: Uploads text data to a specified blob with optional overwrite and content settings.

methods.name: None upload_bytes( self, container: str, blob_name: str, data: bytes | io.BytesIO, overwrite: Optional[bool] = None, content_type: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Uploads bytes or a BytesIO stream to a specified blob with optional overwrite and content-type.

methods.name: bool exists(self, container: str, blob_name: str)
methods.description: Checks whether a specific blob exists in the container.
